page_title: RAY 0-7 ATM | Rayo Vallecano v Atletico Madrid 28/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Jose Luis Munuera Montero is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
90+2' Stefan Savic (Atl. Madrid) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero saw the whole situation. A free kick has been awarded to Rayo Vallecano.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
88' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
87' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
86' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom right corner.
84' 0 - 6 Goal! Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
82' It is time for a substitution. Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) is on for Alfonso Espino.
81' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
79' 0 - 5 Goal! Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) receives the ball on the edge of the box and lobs the goalkeeper, who was off his line. He makes it 0:5.
78' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
77' The ball goes out of play. Rayo Vallecano are awarded a corner kick.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Caglar Soyuncu (Atl. Madrid) replaces Pablo Barrios.
76' It will be a substitution. Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) is ready to enter the pitch as Antoine Griezmann walks off.
75' What was Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

73' 0 - 4 Saul Niguez passes to Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the top right corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 0:4.
71' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
71' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul. Atl. Madrid will take a free kick near the side line.
70' Some great controlled play and passing from Rayo Vallecano. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
68' That's the end of the game for Yannick Carrasco, who is replaced by Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid).
68' Diego Simeone has decided to substitute Rodrigo de Paul and he is replaced by Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid).
67' Here's the change. Isi Palazon leaves the pitch and Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) comes on as a substitute.
66' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
65' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
64' Yellow card. Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
64' A corner kick by Rayo Vallecano is thwarted by the well prepared Jan Oblak (Atl. Madrid).
63' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
62' Some neat passing and movement from Atl. Madrid as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
60' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but Stole Dimitrievski comes off his line to gather the ball.
60' Francisco decides to make a substitution. Raul de Tomas will be replaced by Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano).
59' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) whips the ball into the box and Raul de Tomas takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.
57' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
56' Now Rayo Vallecano have a corner.
55' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the right post and forces a good save out of Jan Oblak.
54' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) receives a reproachful look from Randy Nteka. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails high over the crossbar.
53' A header by Stefan Savic (Atl. Madrid) from very close range goes straight at Stole Dimitrievski, who makes a nice save.
52' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) works the corner short.
52' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) commits a rough challenge and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for an infringement.

51' Yannick Carrasco (Atl. Madrid) latches on to the corner kick and releases a quick strike from the edge of the box. The result differs significantly from his intention as the ball flies way over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
50' The ball goes out of play. Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
50' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
49' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
49' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) receives a pass and unleashes a shot which goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
48' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
46' Half-time substitution. Francisco decided to make a change. Oscar Trejo is replaced by Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano).
46' Francisco has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) comes on the pitch for Unai Lopez.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+7' The end of the first half.
45+7' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Jan Oblak makes a comfortable save.
45+7' Rayo Vallecano can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

45+6' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

45+5' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
45+3' Yannick Carrasco (Atl. Madrid) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
45+2' Looks like Yannick Carrasco (Atl. Madrid) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
45+2' Yannick Carrasco (Atl. Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
43' Atl. Madrid couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Stole Dimitrievski (Rayo Vallecano) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
42' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) makes a strong challenge and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Atl. Madrid.
40' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
39' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
39' Atl. Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
36' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner in trademark fashion.
35' Problems for Diego Simeone as Memphis Depay is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) replaces him.
34' Yannick Carrasco (Atl. Madrid) collects a pass and has an effort from distance which is blocked.

33' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) beats the defender to the lofted pass inside the box, but can't control his shot and it flashes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
32' The linesman makes the right call and Rayo Vallecano will have a corner.
32' Rayo Vallecano couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Jan Oblak (Atl. Madrid) leaped high and intercepted the cross.

31' Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! It's a free kick to Rayo Vallecano in a dangerous position.
30' Dangerous play by Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano). Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for a foul.
29' A short through ball almost allows Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) to get in a good shooting position, but he loses it to one of the defenders.
29' Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
27' Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
26' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
26' Rayo Vallecano have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
25' An attempted cross from Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) is cleared. The ball is out of play and Rayo Vallecano manage to earn a corner.
25' Good work from Rayo Vallecano as they win a corner.
24' A crossfield pass from Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) fails to find any of his teammates.
22' Stefan Savic (Atl. Madrid) sends a long cross over to Memphis Depay, but Stole Dimitrievski comes forward to gather the ball.
22' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 0:3.

20' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks more accuracy and goes way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
18' There's an opportunity for Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

16' 0 - 2 It's a goal! Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) scores with a brilliant low shot into the middle of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Saul Niguez. The score is now 0:2.
14' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle and signals a foul after Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) brought his opponent down.
13' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
12' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
10' A cross from a corner kick by Rayo Vallecano is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
9' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
9' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Yannick Carrasco (Atl. Madrid) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Rayo Vallecano.
7' Jose Luis Munuera Montero couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid) and blew his whistle.
6' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for a foul. Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a free kick.
5' Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the left side of the goal. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
2' 0 - 1 Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) meets a perfect cross from Rodrigo de Paul deep inside the box, and he produces an accurate strike which goes into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.
2' A spell of possession for Atl. Madrid in an attempt to control the game.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Jan Oblak easily deals with the threat.
The players are out at last! Rayo Vallecano will take the kick-off.
Jose Luis Munuera Montero will referee today's match.
